G.A. _____________________________________________________________________________   Court No. - 79   HON'BLE ANISH KUMAR GUPTA, J. 
Order on Crl. Misc. Amendment Application 1.
The amendment application has been filed by learned counsel for the applicants in Application U/S 482 No. 16016 of 2023 today in Court, which is taken on record.
2. Office is directed to allot number to the said application.
3. The amendment application is allowed.
4. Learned counsel for the applicants are directed to carry out necessary amendments during course of the day.

Order on Applications under Section 482 Cr.P.C.
1. Heard Sri Ashish Beg, Advocate holding brief of Sri Anwar Hussain, learned counsel for the applicants in Application U/S 482 No. 10256 of 2023, Sri Pavan Kumar Mishra, learned counsel is appearing for the applicants in Application U/S 482 No. 16016 of 2023 and Application U/S 482 No.
15313 of 2023, which are arising out of the cross case lodged by the opposite party no.2 against the applicants in those cases.
2. Vide order dated 28.03.2023 passed in leading case i.e. Application U/S 482 No.10256 of 2023,
matter was referred to the mediation centre for mediation between the parties.

All the cases herein are arising out of the matrimonial discord between the applicant no.1 (Ritik Sagar) and the opposite party no.2 (Prachi) who were the husband and wife respectively.
3.

As per the mediation report dated 02.08.2023 received in the leading case i.e. Application U/S 482 No.10256 of 2023 and the parties have settled all their matrimonial disputes against each other and the applicant no.1 and the opposite party no.2 in the leading case have decided to dissolve their Ritik Sengar And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. 4. It has also been settled settled between the parties that all the civil and criminal cases filed against each other regarding the present matrimonial dispute shall be withdrawn by the parties by taking appropriate steps against each other.

In terms of the settlement dated 02.08.2023 arrived at between the parties before the mediation centre of this Court reads as under:
"This SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT entered into on 02.08.2023, between Ritik Sengar (Applicant No. 1-Husband) and Prachi (O.P. No. 2-Wife).
WHEREAS 1. Disputes and differences had arisen between the Parties hereto Application U/S 482 No. 10256 of 2023 as filed before the Hon'ble High Court.
2.

The matter was referred to mediation/conciliation vide order dated 28.03.2023 passed by bench of Hon'ble J.J. Munir, J.
3.

The parties agreed that Ms. Alpana Dwivedi and Mr. Rajiv Kumar Singh,
Advocates would act as their Conciliator/Mediator, in the Mediation Case No.
2287/2023.
4.

Several Joint and separate meetings were held during the process of Conciliation/Mediation on 06-06-2023, 27-06-2023, 19-07-2023 and 02-08-2023 and the parties have with the assistance of the Mediator/Conciliator voluntarily arrived at an amicable solution resolving the above-mentioned disputes and differences.

5. The marriage of Ritik Sengar (Applicant No. 1-Husband) and Prachi (O.P. No.
2-Wife) was solemnized on 23.11.2017.
Out of aforesaid wedlock, parties have no issue.
The parties have been living separately since 19.02.2020.
6. The parties hereto confirm and declare that they have voluntarily and of their own free will arrived at this Settlement Agreement in the presence of the Mediators/Conciliators.

7. The following settlement has been arrived at between the Parties hereto:-
(a) That the parties have already settled their dispute and decided to live separately and in this regard they have filed a petition u/s 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act Ritik Sengar And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 6 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/131195009/

(c) That today i.c. 02.08.2023 the applicant no. 1-husband has handed over two demand drafts bearing nos. 812292 & 383322 both dated 25.07.2023 for Rs.5,00,000/-(Rupees Five Lakh only) & Rs.3,00,000/- (Rupees Three Lakh only)

170 of 2023 pending in Family Court, Firozabad by way of demand draft.

(e) That the wife is residing in House No. A-187, Shahstripuram, Agra, P.S.-Sikandra,
District-Agra which is owned by Meena Sengar mother of the husband at present.
Prior to passing the final decree the key and physical possession of the house will be transferred by the wife to the mother of the husbandwho is owner of the house alongwith all household goods.

(f) That it has also been agreed between the parties that all civil and criminal cases filed by them against each other regarding present matrimonial dispute shall be withdrawn by the parties concerned by taking appropriate steps before the Court/authority concerned.(g) That the parties will not file any fresh case against each other in respect of this matrimonial dispute.
They have no claim against each other in future also.
(h) That it has been agreed between the parties that they shall not violate the terms and conditions of this settlement otherwise the aggrieved party will be free to take legal recourse.

8-By signing this Agreement the Parties hereto state that the Application U/S 482 No. 10256 of 2023 and all disputes and differences in this regard have been amicably settled by the Parties hereto through the process of Conciliation/Mediation."
